text: An order must be marked as shipped once the carrier confirms pickup.
A patient's allergy list must be updated whenever a new prescription is entered.
A smart lock must relock automatically after the door is closed.
A support ticket must be reassigned when the original agent goes offline.
A deployment must be rolled back if the health check fails.
A flagged comment must be hidden from public view pending moderator review.
A player's inventory must be restored to its pre-match state after the match ends.
A shipment must be marked as delayed when it misses its scheduled departure.
A student's course progress must be saved when they exit a lesson.
A permit application must be forwarded to a reviewing officer once submitted.
A wire transfer must be held for compliance review when the recipient account is newly added.
An employee's access badge must be deactivated on their last working day.
A meeting recording must stop automatically when the host leaves the call.
A document must be locked for editing while another user has it open.
A downloaded file must be removed from local storage after the app is uninstalled.
A user's session must be terminated if their account is flagged as compromised.
An API key must be revoked once it is reported as leaked.
A gift card balance must be transferred to a new card.
Expired promotional codes must be removed from the active codes list.
A cancelled order must be processed by the fulfillment team.
The system must archive user accounts that have been inactive for 12 months.
The moderation queue must flag messages containing prohibited content.
When a build fails twice in a row, the pipeline must escalate the incident to the on-call engineer.
Duplicate customer records must be merged automatically.
The system must clean up temporary files after a job completes.
Stale cache entries must be cleared during off-peak hours.
Inbound support emails must be routed to the appropriate department.
All PII fields must be sanitized before being logged.
Inventory counts must be normalized across all warehouse systems nightly.
Failed login attempts must be audited for security review.
Duplicate invoice line items must be consolidated before the invoice is finalized.
